description: List the newest media assets for the authenticated user. After create_media_drop, pass drop_session_id to see files the human uploaded on /drop/<token>. Use public_url with validate_post / create_post. A drop listing returns up to 20 files per page by default so a full drop fits one page. The output says whether every matching file is shown; page with offset (offset + limit up to 1000) when it is not.

drop_session_id.description: Filter to files uploaded through one create_media_drop session

limit.description: Number of assets to return (default 10, or 20 when drop_session_id is set; max 50)

offset.description: How many assets to skip. Use the offset the previous page gives to get the next page.

name: list_media
